items: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game item sprite atlas for PKBall Unity. Create ONE square transparent PNG sprite sheet, strict equal 4 columns x 4 rows, exactly 16 isolated items centered inside each cell with 12% empty margins and absolutely no overlapping cell boundaries. Style: playful fantasy mechanical cartoon, clean hand-painted vector-like shapes, thick dark navy outer outlines, cool steel, amber brass trims, soft top-left highlights, saturated cyan, coral and emerald accents, readable at 128px. Match the established PKBall weapon style. No circles behind icons, no badges, no ground shadows, no labels or lettering, no watermarks, true alpha background. Items in exact row-major order: row1 apprentice short steel sword with simple cyan gem; apprentice small brass shield with cyan gem; apprentice poison spellbook with green vial clasp; apprentice flame lantern with coral flame. row2 apprentice regeneration spring stone in brass cage with green sprouts; master sword ornate brass with violet crystal; master shield ornate steel brass violet; master poison spellbook with green snake clasp. row3 master flame lantern with golden coral blaze; master regeneration stone with emerald crystal and brass crown; master activation token diamond brass medallion with cyan runes (no writing); rare random potion cauldron brass kettle with three colored glass bottles. row4 legendary super potion injector machine with multiple glass reservoirs and gold needle pointing diagonally; poison fang dagger green edge; fire battle axe coral steel blade; brass shield generator machine cyan central crystal. Consistent scale and 3/4 icon perspective. All 16 separate objects fit cleanly in their own equal cells.
ui: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: modular Unity UGUI game interface sprite atlas, NOT a complete screen. One square transparent PNG, exactly four columns and four rows of sixteen separate components, each centered in its own equal square cell with 15% transparent padding, none touching cell boundary. Fantasy mechanical cartoon, clean dark navy outline, amber brass light trims, cyan and coral highlights, cream steel, soft top-left light. Restrained elegant UI: NO giant ornamental frames, no icons embedded into panels, no text, no letters, no numbers, no characters, no background scene. Exact row-major arrangement: Row1: player tall rectangular navy equipment-panel backing with very thin brass rounded edges and minimal cyan upper corner accents, simple quiet flat interior; enemy tall rectangular matching panel with coral accents; simple square navy item tile with thin brass edge (no large gold surround); square translucent charcoal cooldown surface with simple flat interior and soft rounded corners. Row2: long horizontal empty health-bar frame brass outer edge with dark recessed inner trough, no filling; long horizontal cyan health fill strip simple rounded ends no frame; long coral-red health fill strip no frame; long warm gold shield fill strip no frame. Row3: slim horizontal energy-bar empty frame dark steel brass edge; cyan energy fill strip no frame; small plain dark rounded badge backing for production count; long flat navy title-strip simple thin brass edges. Row4: simple compact cyan button backing flat dark center no symbol; matching coral button backing; small shield status icon brass cyan; small green healing leaf-and-cross status icon. All long horizontal shapes exactly horizontal, all tile shapes geometrically regular, panel centers uninterrupted solid quiet color, border design safe for nine-slice scaling. Actual alpha transparency outside each asset, no shadows cast into neighboring cells. Components share one visual language and can be sliced and reused independently.
arena: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: modular top-down circular arena texture sprite sheet for a cartoon fantasy mechanical Unity game. Landscape image, exactly TWO equally sized square cells side by side. TRUE alpha transparency around both components. Left cell: perfectly circular top-down arena FLOOR DISC ONLY, pale desaturated slate blue stone, large simple clean tiles, subtle concentric inset brass seams, quiet low contrast center with very few details so moving ball characters remain readable; NO outer rail, no raised wall, no props, no symbols or lettering. Right cell: matching perfectly circular ARENA RIM ONLY, a thin warm brass and dark slate mechanical rail, top-down orthographic, round outside and round inside, hollow center with FULL TRANSPARENCY, outer diameter identical to left disc, rim thickness only 6% of disc diameter, four small restrained cyan accents, no solid interior ground. Both components centered inside their own cells with 10% transparent margins. Clean hand painted vector-like fantasy cartoon, dark navy outlines, amber brass, cool steel, consistent soft top-left highlights. Geometrically exact circles, no oval perspective, no characters, weapons, UI cards, text, numbers, background or separate cast shadows. This is TWO independent assets to slice, not two finished scenes.
background: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: full-screen landscape background for PKBall circular duel arena UI, no arena embedded. Wide 16:9 composition. Playful fantasy mechanical cartoon, clean hand-painted vector-like large color shapes with dark navy outlines and soft top-left highlights. Quiet desaturated deep teal slate workshop courtyard seen straight top-down, low contrast center occupying middle 65% left entirely spacious and unobstructed, dim large stone pavement, only restrained brass mechanical architecture and a few leaves along extreme corners. Cool blue-grey, deep navy #10243C, very restrained amber brass #D99832 accents. The background is placed behind an independently rendered circular arena and equipment panels; do NOT draw any circle, arena disc, circular wall, cards, sidebar, HUD, border overlay, characters, objects in central space, lettering or watermark. Very little detail, no bright particles, no visual noise, no heavy textures, no perspective tilt. Crisp polished cartoon game backdrop with no UI built in.
